opportunities.name: arXiv topic search → Semantic Scholar citation count → save note
opportunities.description: For a given research topic and year, run an arXiv advanced search (title, subject category, specific year), open the top result, look up its title on Semantic Scholar for author and citation count, then add a formatted note '<topic> (<year>): <title> by <first author>, <N> citations'.
steps: On arxiv.org click Search, then Advanced search (or New search from a results page)
Type the topic into the 'Search term' field (field = Title)
Tick the subject category checkbox (e.g. Computer Science, Quantitative Biology)
Select the 'Specific year' radio and type the year
Click Search and open the first result's arXiv link
Copy the paper title
On semanticscholar.org paste the title into the search box and submit
Open the matching result; read the first author and citation count
In the Notes app click 'New note', type '<topic> (<year>): <title> by <first author>, <citations> citations' and press Enter

instances.values: topic='retrieval augmented generation', category=Computer Science, year=2023 → RIGHT: Retrieval-augmented Generation for Mainstream Hashtag Recommendation, Run-Ze Fan, 11 citations
topic='protein structure diffusion', category=Quantitative Biology, year=2024 → Accelerating Inference in Molecular Diffusion Models..., Ian Dunn, 7 citations
topic='graph neural networks traffic forecasting', category=Computer Science, year field started but never finished (abandoned)

opportunities.name: Case citation lookup (CourtListener) + related statute (Cornell LII) → save note
opportunities.description: For a given case name and related statute, find the case on CourtListener to get its reporter citation and decision date, look up the statute's section title on Cornell LII, then add a note '<case>: <citation>, decided <date>. See <statute> (<section title>)'.
steps: On courtlistener.com type the case name into 'Keyword(s) search with operators' and press Enter
Open the matching Supreme Court opinion in the results
Read the U.S. Reports citation and the decision date
On law.cornell.edu (LII) type the statute citation into the search box and submit
Open the matching U.S. Code section result and read its title
In the Notes app click 'New note', type '<case>: <citation>, decided <date>. See <statute> (<section title>)' and press Enter

opportunities.name: Peerspace venue search by activity and city
opportunities.description: Search Peerspace for venues by entering an activity type and a city, picking the suggested options, and running the search to browse the listings.
steps: Click the 'What are you planning?' activity combobox, select all and type the activity
Choose the matching activity suggestion from the dropdown
Click the 'Where?' location combobox, select all and type the city
Choose the matching city suggestion (e.g. 'San Francisco, CA, USA')
Click Search and browse the listing results
